company.name: Brapper
company.shortDescription: Brapper - No1 Social Network for motorcycle riders. iOS/Android Mobile App
company.description:
Brapper - Social Network for motorcyclists and B2B2C platform. 
A social media App serving bikers communities across the world including riders and service providers. We assist members to identify other riders in the region or in the future destination their planning to travel to. Assist to identify the type of riders based on age, bike type, gender, organizing trips in advance even with short notice. An App where riders and service providers can post their daily/seasonal activity, experiences, and services.  

Brapper is designed in such a way to serve the bikers community particularly without getting the effect of the unnecessary huge flow of media data not serving the purpose as in the other Apps which make it very practical for users to get from it what they need and service providers for whom they are targeting.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for motorcycle riders to connect, share experiences, and access community features on iOS and Android platforms.
